name: burpee power sled push
description: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.
instructions: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.
